description: Returns the health check of a retrospective: score per category on a 0-10 scale, alignment between participants, turnout, and the same score across the previous retrospectives of the team. Returns health_check: null when the team did not run a health check on this board.

board_id.description: The ID of the board to get the health check report for.

name: retro.board.health.get
title: Get Board Health Tool
